correctness.rationale: M^2=PM+I and tr(M^n)=V_n. For odd P, M^6≡5I(mod8) and M^3≡I(mod2). These give every valuation case exactly; induction on squared scalar M powers produces odd-bit lifting at all dyadic precisions. Two mod-4 base residues give all odd residues. Fixed positive-index terms of valuations 0,1,2 and dense odd-index terms give all five closure shells. All topological exclusions and zero are explicit. The embedded standalone 16-parameter verifier passed actual finite tests, not used as an infinite proof.
